claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Space Access: Where We've Been and Where We Could Go", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-03-08 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1001-006. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

claims.text: Author of record per the DIA letter of 9 January 2018 to the Senate Armed Services Committee, item 4: "Space Access, Dr P Czysz, HyperTech."
The released cover page reads "March 2010 / ICOD: 1 December 2009 / DIA-08-1001-006," series "Acquisition Threat Support," full title "Space Access: Where We've Been ... and Where We Could Go."

Inside cover administrative note: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program." The author line reads "Author: [redacted (b)(6)]."

Contents are conventional hypersonics and launch engineering: propulsion perspective, hypersonic configuration concepts, thermodynamics and materials, rocket propulsion, launch options, atmospheric variations, and appendices on transatmospheric vehicle operational costs and landing ellipses for hypersonic gliders. No anomalous-physics content.
